entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: Human Atarka-clan warrior and hunter in Tarkir's past, granddaughter of Yasova Dragonclaw and twin of Baishya.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: Naiva's twin sister with shamanistic tendencies.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: Grandmother of the twins who tricked Bolas.

entities.name: Kiarka
entities.description: Mother of the twins, killed by Atarka as a Temur Whisperer.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: Elder dragon who killed Kiarka and confronted the hunting band.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: Ghostfire Warrior who shared Shu Yun's knowledge and had a vision of Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who offered Naiva the reign of Tarkir; fled Tarkir after Yasova's trick.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit dragon whose grave Bolas confronted them at and whose survival remained secret.

entities.name: Eternal Ice
entities.description: Holy mountain Baishya felt the need to climb.

entities.name: Windfolk
entities.description: Gave Baishya a vision of the birth of Ugin and the Elder Dragons.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Artifact Yasova claimed targeted Ugin's grave.

events.summary: Naiva accompanied Baishya up the Eternal Ice; they survived an avalanche and goblins and met Windfolk who gave Baishya a vision.
events.quote: Together, they survived an avalanche and an attack by goblins.

events.summary: Yasova's band fled the Atarka dragons and set out to find the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon.
events.quote: the band of Yasova fled the Atarka dragons

events.summary: Tae Jin's vision of Nicol Bolas impressed Atarka and saved the band.
events.quote: They were only saved because Tae Jin had a vision of Nicol Bolas

events.summary: Bolas offered Naiva the reign of Tarkir for surrendering her grandmother and twin; she was tempted.
events.quote: He offered her the reign of Tarkir

events.summary: Yasova tricked Bolas into fleeing Tarkir, so Ugin's survival was never revealed to him.

relations.quote: She was the granddaughter of Yasova Dragonclaw

relations.note: Because she was a Temur Whisperer
relations.quote: Atarka had killed their mother Kiarka
